british-falkland-islands.title: Flag of the Falkland Islands

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the South Atlantic.
The ram on the coat of arms, representing the sheep farming industry.

desc: - A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of the Falkland Islands in the fly
- The arms feature a ram above a sailing ship (Desire), representing the islands' sheep farming and maritime heritage
trivia:
- The Falkland Islands are claimed by both Britain and Argentina
- The flag shows the Union Jack and the Falkland Islands coat of arms
- The 1982 Falkland Islands War was fought over territorial control
